sources.name: NHL schedule, NHL.com, NST, goalie reports, DraftKings, Yahoo
reasons: Unknown means no current observation, not that the goalie is not starting. Observations cover part of the slate.

evidence.sample: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08: 102 upcoming team games; rates are season to date through 2026-10-31. Unknown means no current observation, not that the goalie is not starting. Observations cover part of the slate. Moneylines and totals are market lines, the book's own prices, not FHFH numbers. NHL.com's feed covers only its current odds date, so a later game shows No line yet.
evidence.cohort: 102 team-nights in the window; ranks over all 32 teams. These signals are correlated: shots, xG and chances overlap, and penalties feed all three. Each lens stands alone, flags are never added across lenses, and no win or start odds are given. All situations (shots, xG, chances); PP and PK as labeled. Sources: NHL schedule through 2026-11-08 · NHL.com team game stats through 2026-10-31 · NST team game logs (all situations) through 2026-10-31 (updated Nov 1, 4:55 AM ET) · NHL.com goalie game stats through 2026-10-31 · Goalie start observations · DraftKings market lines (stored) through 2026-11-01 (updated Nov 1, 12:34 PM ET) · NHL.com partner odds · Yahoo matchup weeks.
